violations.affected_code: InkWell(onTap: onRemove, customBorder: const CircleBorder(), child: const SizedBox(width: 20, height: 20, ...))
violations.explanation: The remove button's tappable area is only 20x20 logical pixels, well below the recommended minimum of 48x48 dp (Material) / 44x44 pt (iOS). This makes it difficult for users with motor impairments to activate.

Long file names are visually truncated with an ellipsis, so sighted users (including low-vision users) cannot read the full name. No tooltip or alternative way to view the full name is provided. Screen readers still read the full text.
